scope: Exact four-source SPI4 private finite-DMA observed held-reset containment; no D2 generated integration or broader runtime-domain qualification inherited.

official_basis.observed_text: DMA1RST resets DMA1 and DMAMUX1; DMA2RST resets DMA2 and DMAMUX1. DMA2 reset does not reset DMA1 engine registers.

production_review: live() observes RCC AHB1RSTR DMA1RST|DMA2RST before DMA1 gate or any DMA/DMAMUX source probe; reset is independent of DMA1EN.

irq_domain() requires the same two reset bits clear before DMA source observation. A failing domain permanently latches existing tainted, records STATE only when terminal was SUCCESS, quarantines the existing active request and isolates only its owned IRQ13/14/84.

service() checks live/tainted before time/drain/source work and now records STATE as first terminal cause; earlier CANCELLED/TIMEOUT/IO remain unchanged. Sticky taint prevents a restored reset bit from authorizing drain/settlement.
Second valid READY submit under a held reset rejects STATE without taking the second request, while retaining/quarantining the original accepted request. Before first submit no borrow is created.

No public/private state layout, ops table, request type, factory, generated graph, DMA cancellation sequence or normal completion path is changed. Two RCC observations plus terminal assignment are the only production behavior delta.

No forced EN0, reset-bit clear, peripheral reset, address clear or SETTLED publication is introduced by containment. A loan whose runtime proof has been invalidated remains retained; fail-stop isolation semantics are reused.
model_and_tests_review: External assert_reset clears DMA1 engine+stream registers and shared mux for DMA1RST; DMA2RST clears only shared mux, preserving DMA1 registers. SPI/NVIC are separate domains. Independent model self-check distinguishes both cases before the SUT scenario.

held_in_reset ignores writes only to hardware held by that reset; reset_domain_accesses conservatively records any DMA/mux probing under either shared reset, so GREEN proves rejection before those probes.
All new reset scenarios explicitly assert no pending RX transaction before injection; no outstanding-bus reset completion or abort behavior is modeled or claimed.

Parent observes child retained/tainted/request state with release/acquire shared trace, checks owned IRQ isolation and unrelated IRQ12 preservation, restores the injected bit only inside the child and proves no automatic recovery, then kill/wait joins the child. Process reclamation is not claimed as provider cleanup.
